title: SNATCH – Arctic Mint
description:
Snatch Arctic Mint Strong is a slimmed nicotine pouch with a cooling taste of mint. The pleasant nicotine taste together with it’s 16mg/g nicotine strength creates a pleasant experience for any user who likes the classic mint flavored nicotine pouch.

Snatch Arctic Mint comes with 20 all white pouches that won’t stain your teeth and gives you a controlled release of both nicotine and flavor.

CONTENT AND INFORMATION

- Nicotine mg/g: 16

- Nicotine mg/pouch: 11,2

- Content: 14g

- Format: Slim

- Manufacturer: Consumer Brands International
